sketches.mechanism: A recursive binding can be given any type; under non-strict evaluation it is accepted, but forcing it diverges as bottom.
sketches.resonance: It can promise to become anything only because it never arrives.

sketches.mechanism: A let binding is in the temporal dead zone during its own initializer, so the inner name shadows all others but cannot yet be read.
sketches.resonance: The self is named before it exists, and that naming makes return impossible.

sketches.mechanism: A for loop over a null range is legal and executes its body zero times.
sketches.resonance: A whole ritual is declared, then the empty interval quietly refuses every step.
